description: About the Event The AI Hackathon is an event organised by Infinity - The Tech Society of Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, University of Delhi , as part of TechTonics 2026. Teams of four will compete to build a website based on a problem statement revealed at the venue. Participants will have 90 minutes (1.5 hours) to brainstorm, design, develop, and finalise their websites using AI tools. The event aims to promote innovation, problem-solving, teamwork, and the practical application of AI in web development. Eligibility Each team must consist of maximum 4 members . Registration must be completed as a team through Unstop. All team members must be registered before the competition begins. Rules and Guidelines The competition will be conducted offline at Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, University of Delhi. The problem statement will be disclosed at the venue. Teams must develop their websites within the allotted 90 minutes. Participants must bring their own laptops and ensure they are ready for use. Teams must submit their final website before the deadline. Plagiarism, copying another team's work, or submitting someone else's work as original may result in disqualification. Participants must follow all instructions given by the organisers. The judges' decision will be final. Event Format and Process Mode: Offline Venue: Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, University of Delhi Duration: 90 minutes Team Size: 4 members Competition Format: The problem statement will be announced at the venue. Teams will plan and build a website using AI tools. Participants must complete and submit their website within 90 minutes. Each team will give a short demo of its website to the judges. Winners will be determined based on the judging criteria. Judging Criteria Innovation and Creativity: Originality of the idea and approach. Functionality: Working features and usability of the website. Relevance: Effectiveness in addressing the given problem statement. Design

raw.details:
About the Event

  • The AI Hackathon is an event organised by Infinity - The Tech Society of Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, University of Delhi, as part of TechTonics 2026.

  • Teams of four will compete to build a website based on a problem statement revealed at the venue.

  • Participants will have 90 minutes (1.5 hours) to brainstorm, design, develop, and finalise their websites using AI tools.

  • The event aims to promote innovation, problem-solving, teamwork, and the practical application of AI in web development.

Eligibility

  • Each team must consist of maximum 4 members.

  • Registration must be completed as a team through Unstop.

  • All team members must be registered before the competition begins.

Rules and Guidelines

  • The competition will be conducted offline at Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, University of Delhi.

  • The problem statement will be disclosed at the venue.

  • Teams must develop their websites within the allotted 90 minutes.

  • Participants must bring their own laptops and ensure they are ready for use.

  • Teams must submit their final website before the deadline.

  • Plagiarism, copying another team's work, or submitting someone else's work as original may result in disqualification.

  • Participants must follow all instructions given by the organisers.

  • The judges' decision will be final.

Event Format and Process

  • Mode: Offline

  • Venue: Sri Guru Gobind Singh College of Commerce, University of Delhi

  • Duration: 90 minutes

  • Team Size: 4 members

  • Competition Format:

    • The problem statement will be announced at the venue.

    • Teams will plan and build a website using AI tools.

    • Participants must complete and submit their website within 90 minutes.

    • Each team will give a short demo of its website to the judges.

    • Winners will be determined based on the judging criteria.

Judging Criteria

  • Innovation and Creativity: Originality of the idea and approach.

  • Functionality: Working features and usability of the website.

  • Relevance: Effectiveness in addressing the given problem statement.

  • Design and User Experience: Visual appeal, navigation, and ease of use.

  • Effective Use of AI: Appropriate and meaningful use of permitted AI tools.

Important Instructions

  • Participants must bring their own laptops and any necessary accessories.

  • Teams should ensure access to their required accounts and development platforms.

  • Internet availability will depend on venue facilities; participants should plan accordingly.

  • Participants must report to the venue at the time communicated by the organisers.

  • The organisers reserve the right to make necessary changes to the event schedule or guidelines, with due communication to participants.
